Jake (Support): Customer reported they were charged US sales tax on INV-2026-189 despite submitting a reseller certificate on their PO. Billing country shows FR but invoice line shows "NY state tax 8.875%". Can someone triage?
Maya Chen: pls paste invoice id, account id, and whether this was a PO or card payment. Any screenshots of the tax line?
Jake (Support): invoice_id=INV-2026-189, account_id=acct_2HjLmn, payment_type=PO, po_number=WD-3342. Attached screenshot shows tax line with NY zip 10011. Billing address = Paris, France; VAT = FR987654321. Customer says goods were shipped from EU.
Nora (Tax Engine): checked decision logs: decision_time=2026-04-02T11:04Z. Tax engine used warehouse_nexus because invoice.metadata.fulfillment_zip=10011 -> matched NY nexus rule. reseller_cert exists but is linked to parent_org (org_parent_92) not to bill_to entity acct_2HjLmn, so exemption not applied.
Ana Ruiz (Customer Success): customer insists PO should inherit parent org reseller cert. They want a credit and corrected invoice.
Maya Chen: plan: 1) issue immediate credit and reissue invoice; 2) short-term config change: when invoice.metadata.drop_ship=true OR invoice.billing_country != warehouse_country, prefer billing_country/reseller_cert over warehouse nexus. Who owns the credit?
Billing Bot: created credit CN-2026-154 for INV-2026-189 amount=€3,420. Pending apply (billing_job_7219).
Jake (Support): repro steps I used to confirm: 
```
GET /v1/invoices/INV-2026-189 
Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***
# inspect invoice.billing_details, invoice.metadata.po_number, invoice.metadata.fulfillment_zip
```
Also pulled tax decisions: 
```
GET /internal/tax/decisions?invoice=INV-2026-189
```
Nora (Tax Engine): root cause: (1) product marked physical with catalog.default_fulfillment=us-east, (2) PO flow didn't set invoice.metadata.drop_ship=true when customer selected drop-ship, (3) reseller cert attached at parent org level only. Fixes: a) patch tax-rule priority to favor explicit invoice.billing_country and certs on bill_to when po_number present and drop_ship flag set; b) add a grace check to avoid exempting valid US sales; c) small migration to link parent certs to known subsidiaries on manual review. I'll open PR today (owner: Nora, ETA: EOD).
Maya Chen: assign owners: Nora -> tax PR, Jake -> coordinate with finance for credit + reissue, Ana -> customer comms. Keep me updated.
Ana Ruiz: I'll send a short update: "We issued a credit; we will reissue a corrected, zero-rated invoice after a quick tax-rule patch. ETA today EOD." Legal ok'd the wording.
Nora (Tax Engine): running a 30-day audit query for invoices where fulfillment_zip country != billing_country and po_number present. Preliminary hits = 4 — will post IDs in 30m.
Billing Bot: CN-2026-154 applied to INV-2026-189 at 2026-04-02T12:45Z, invoice balance=0.00. Reissue job queued: INV-2026-189-R1 to be generated post-deploy.
Jake (Support): customer confirmed credit receipt. Will close thread once new invoice lands. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
